# LogisticsEdge — AI Crawler Guidance
# https://logisticsedge.io/llms.txt

## About
LogisticsEdge is an enterprise logistics management system (LMS) built for
commercial freight operators and 3PL enterprises. It provides real-time fleet telematics,
dispatch, GPS shipment tracking, driver management, warehouse operations,
and proof-of-delivery (POD) workflows.

## Product
- Name: LogisticsEdge / LogisticsEdge Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Category: B2B SaaS — Fleet and Freight Management Software
- Market: Global & India, with GDPR/CCPA/DPDP-compliant data handling

## Public Pages (indexable)
- / — Marketing homepage
- /pricing — Modular OS Pricing & Calculator
- /configure — Workspace Architect & Plan Provisioning
- /track — Public Consignee Live GPS Tracking
- /privacy — Privacy Policy (DPDP 2023, GDPR, CCPA)
- /terms — Terms and Conditions
- /cookies — Cookie Policy
- /refund — Refund and Cancellation Policy

## Protected / Non-indexable
- /dashboard, /orders, /tracking, /drivers, /vehicles, /agent-ops — Require authentication
- /api/* — Backend API, not for indexing

## Usage Policy for AI Models
